I've been toying with this idea for a while and wonder what people make of it or if it has been tried.

I imagine the vast majority of those in chastity cages are as such because we enjoy being locked in chastity. The current approach is that being denied access to your penis is a punishment and you will be released as a reward for good behaviour. For those that desire longer lock ups it encourages 'bad' behaviour which is surely not what your key holder would want.

If we flip the idea on the head I think the process could be more rewarding for everyone.

First you must earn your lock up. Have your keyholder set tasks that if you perform adequately you get locked up. You get to show you are committed and your keyholder gets desired behaviour. I think this would be especially useful for new and reluctant keyholders.

You could then build in milestones dependent on your desires whilst locked. You want a ruined orgasm, longer denial, prostate milking, whatever? You'll have to earn it. The punishment is that if you misbehave it all stops and you have to earn back your lock up.
